applies_to: new confirm contracts only, as selection.invalid_policy; a contract without it keeps the strict rule (any INVALID branch: INCONCLUSIVE). Past contracts, records and verdicts are not re-judged.

meaning.structural_abnormal_end: a replay-verified end with black to move, one empty point that is black-forbidden and no winner scores 0.5 in this evaluation only (an evaluation draw); the INVALID branch record stays as it is
meaning.unresolved: an unresolved candidate branch scores 0, an unresolved champion branch 1
meaning.max_invalid_share: proposed 0.05, not fixed: observations with an unresolved branch / all disagreement observations
